summary: Verified Siroco Producciones fixes: (1) Event gallery renders 69 bundled static photos, independent of the (now empty) /api/gallery DB response. (2) Static assets served correctly. (3) WhatsApp floating button on both / and /admin with correct href. (4) Artists section and nav link fully removed from public site. (5) Admin login works and Galería tab shows 0 uploaded photos. All requested features pass.

admin.message_shown: Aún no hay fotos. Se mostrarán unas imágenes por defecto hasta que subas las tuyas.

critical_code_review_comments: Admin panel still shows an 'ARTISTAS' tab even though public-facing artists section has been removed. If artists concept is fully deprecated, consider removing the admin-side Artistas tab and related endpoints for cleanliness. If admin CMS still uses it for internal data, this is fine.

Design note: eventGallery.js hardcodes 69 static paths — future admin-uploaded photos are appended at runtime, which is correct. Ensure the frontend build includes /public/media/events/gallery/ on every deploy (already the intent of the fix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 review-request items verified pass in the preview env. Login form inputs have data-testid admin-email and admin-password (no type=email); use these selectors. Submit button has no type=submit, click by text 'ACCEDER'. Gallery paths: /media/events/gallery/ev-01.jpg..ev-69.jpg (all 200).
